subject: Pilot success plan template + evaluation tracker
messages:
From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@heliolabs.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@heliolabs.com
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot plan / evaluation tracker request

Hi Hannah / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency and cost profile looked promising. Our engineering and procurement leads asked if you could share a lightweight pilot success plan (MAP) and an evaluation checklist we can run against our staging workload. Key asks from our side:
- A short milestone timeline we can share with execs (dates for tech validation, metrics review, acceptance)
- Acceptance criteria (throughput, tail latency, data handling notes)
- Procurement inputs (SOW/PO guidance and any required compliance artifacts)

Can you drop a starter doc (Google Doc or Slides) we can iterate on? We aim to start a 4–6 week pilot and would like to align stakeholders before next Friday.

Also looping in Samira from our procurement team (procurement@heliolabs.com) for any contract/timing questions.

Appreciate it — Alex

Alex Carter
Director of Engineering, Helio Labs
alex.carter@heliolabs.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@heliolabs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, procurement@heliolabs.com
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot plan / evaluation tracker request

Alex — thanks, great to hear the demo resonated. I stubbed a compact MAP and an evaluation tracker to make kickoff faster:

- Doc: Helio-Redwood_MAP_v1.gdoc (link below) — a one-page plan + a 6-week timeline you can copy.
- Eval spreadsheet: Pilot-eval-checklist.xlsx — row-per-test, owner, pass/fail, notes.

Proposed timeline (high level):
Week 0 (tech validation): shared access, small smoke runs, infra checklist
Week 1 (integration): end-to-end runs on staging, initial metrics collection
Week 3 (performance review): 95/99th latency check, throughput targets, sample outputs
Week 5 (final acceptance): run acceptance workload, confirm cutover steps and rollback plan

Acceptance criteria (examples to start):
- < 150 ms median response for 1k qps simulated workload
- 99th percentile latency < 800 ms for target seq lengths
- Token cost estimates within agreed budget envelope
- No data leaves customer VPC (if private deployment) — audit log sample provided

I added placeholders for stakeholder names and owners (tech lead, security reviewer, procurement contact). Would like to keep the initial doc narrow so it’s easy for your team to review.

Links / attachments:
- https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeFGh_helio_map_stub  (Helio-Redwood_MAP_v1.gdoc)
- Google Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1PilotEvalStub (Pilot-eval-checklist.xlsx)

Action items for Helio: confirm primary tech contact + week0 availability, and tell us any additional acceptance tests you want included.

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Redwood Inference — Production-grade LLM inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 25 Mar 2028 08:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot plan / evaluation tracker request

Hannah — quick notes after reviewing the draft:
- Add a clear column in the eval sheet for "data sensitivity" (PII, PHI, none) so security can triage quickly.
- Add owner assignments for the Week 3 metrics review (suggest Jordan as ops owner, Hannah as CS lead).
- I'll stub a brief slide (Redwood_MAP_slide_v1.gslides) with the 4-week milestone graphic for their execs — keeps the doc to-the-point.

I'll push edits to the doc and sheet by Mon EOD. Also recommend we pre-share our SOC2 summary and audit contact so procurement can move faster.

-Marissa

Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Samira Noor <samira.noor@heliolabs.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Carter <alex.carter@heliolabs.com>, procurement@heliolabs.com
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot plan / evaluation tracker request

Hannah / Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and the starter docs. We reviewed with engineering and procurement this morning. A few notes and next steps from our side:

- Timeline: Pilot week0 start looks good; procurement needs a PO target of 2028-04-20 to keep budget on this quarter.
- Compliance: please attach SOC 2 summary and the auditor contact (we can accept the Redwood redacted pack).
- Eval items: engineering asked to add a stability test (48-hour sustained load) to the checklist. Can you add a row with expected run parameters?
- Stakeholders: our primary tech contact will be Priya Khatri (cc'd in a separate note) and Sam Woo will join the Week 3 review.

We'll split feedback into inline comments on the Google Doc by EOD Monday. Procurement attached a short form (procurement_request.pdf) with PO fields — happy to run that back to you for signature.

Quick logistic Q: Do you have a concise SOW template or should we run with the PO + acceptance checklist only?

Appreciate the help — Samira

Samira Noor
Procurement Manager, Helio Labs
procurement@heliolabs.com
Attachment: procurement_request.pdf (PDF stub, one-page PO fields)
